2026-10-15#20.summary: No filing asks for a decision. Since the October 1 meeting ERCOT has filed three routine notices here: two transmission project notices and the 2027 cybersecurity monitor fee. The open question is the 2027 ancillary service methodology. Last year ERCOT filed its approval request on October 6 and the commission ruled on November 6. No equivalent filing has appeared yet this year.
2026-10-15#20.action: Attend. Listen for when ERCOT will bring the 2027 methodology to the commission.

2026-10-15#21.summary: On September 21 ERCOT filed notice that its Board recommended 18 protocol revisions (NPRRs) and 14 other revision requests. Staff's August 11 timeline memo puts Board actions from September 15 on the November 5 open meeting. Six of the NPRRs are marked urgent. The IMM filed comments in the ERCOT process on three of the 18: NPRR1214, NPRR1301 and NPRR1337.
2026-10-15#21.action: Attend. Note whether any urgent revision is taken up early; otherwise prepare for November 5.

2026-10-15#24.summary: Staff filed its recommended order adopting new 16 TAC §25.58 on October 8. The rule implements PURA §35.153 on contracts between transmission and distribution utilities and power generation companies for electric energy storage.
2026-10-15#24.action: Read Staff's recommended order before the meeting. Flag anything that affects how storage competes in the wholesale market.

2026-10-15#10.summary: Posted for possible final order. This docket was on the agenda and not taken up at the September 11, September 18 and October 1 meetings.
2026-10-15#10.action: Note the outcome and any conditions the commission attaches.

2026-10-15#13.summary: ERCOT gave notice on October 2 that it will file study results and recommendations, and a procedural schedule was set on October 7. Not taken up at the last three meetings.
2026-10-15#13.action: Watch for ERCOT's study filing. It is the first look at how ERCOT weighs a large co-location.

2026-10-15#17.summary: Not taken up at the September 11, September 18 and October 1 meetings.

2026-10-15#33.action: Pull the new calendar when it is filed and add its dates to the deadline calendar.

2026-10-01#14.summary: The commission denied the petition. Chairman Gleeson filed a memo on September 30 recommending denial.

2026-10-01#25.summary: The commission denied the rulemaking petition. Staff recommended denial on September 25.

2026-09-18#11.summary: The commission adopted new 16 TAC §25.194. The Texas Register notice gives an effective date of October 8, 2026.

2026-09-11#20.summary: The commission granted ERCOT's good cause exception. ERCOT keeps the posted ECRS and Non-Spin minimums instead of raising them by about 3,700 MW per hour on average, until the 2027 methodology is approved and implemented. Seven sets of comments were filed. The IMM, the Cities, the Joint Consumers and Goff Policy supported the exception; LCRA, Hunt Energy Network and TCPA opposed it.
2026-09-11#20.action: Done. The IMM's August 20 comments are item 278; the order is item 283.
